samples.narration: Aha separates finding supported answers from designing understandable explanations. Two portable skills connect these tasks.
Start with the reader's question. Research produces a report; explanation authors the requested medium. Skill dispatch is not automatic.
The Research Dossier preserves claims, evidence and gaps. Its hash identifies a snapshot; it does not prove truth.
New evidence creates a new snapshot. Existing works remain bound to the research they used.
HTML offers exploration, PNG one reading path, PowerPoint an editable sequence, and video a changing mechanism. Each needs its own composition.
The ANC interface computes incoming pressure, speaker pressure and their sum. In this ideal equal-amplitude tone model, opposite pressures cancel.
Change the phase. A residual appears, although input amplitudes stay equal. This model is not measured headphone performance.
The Git example selects embedded records. After a revert, ours matches the base; their retained change appears in the result.
Select the conflict record. Different replacements leave an unresolved file; HEAD stays at ours. The page does not run Git.
Aha checks identities, resources and declared coverage. People still judge evidence, language and real output. A receipt cannot replace them.
Video uses browser frames and FFmpeg at thirty frames per second, with segment-level captions. Pixel changes alone do not prove meaningful animation.
Local execution and online speech need separate permission. Visual source edits invalidate the current plan and audio binding.
Choose image dimensions for the request, destination and reading width—not the scaffold's canvas.
Examples hold works. Evaluation folders separate artifact review from skill comparisons. Defined cases are not measured effectiveness.
Preserve evidence. Design relationships. Inspect the result. Aha makes this process traceable; it does not replace its judgments.

visualReview: Extracted actual encoded frames with burned captions; extraction alone is not inspection.
